diagnosis: The server-rendered route checks user session authentication, but queries the invoice solely using the invoice_id path parameter. It does not ensure invoice.customer_id == user.id before rendering the Jinja2 template, allowing authenticated users to display and print other customers' billing statements, itemized purchases, and physical addresses.
exploit_request:
GET /portal/invoices/4491/print HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.example.com
Cookie: session_id=attacker_session_cookie
